evals.name: normal-sync-after-a-source-edit
evals.setup: The Confluence source advanced a version; one rule was reworded upstream. The vr checkout is present and `cfsync pull` has run.
evals.query: Sync the SRD standard from Confluence
evals.requires: the private `vr` checkout (the cfsync mirror named by `dev/check-srd-standard.sh`), or a stand-in source pointed at by `SRD_STANDARD_SRC`. Without one this scenario cannot be executed, only narrated — a stand-in tests that the transform and checks are self-consistent, never that they match the real Confluence export.
